payload.title: stories list/show: stars, filters, sorting, and stories set-stars
payload.description: From the Anthus news desk editing session (Ryan's request), 2026-11-09: 'papyrus stories list' and 'papyrus stories show' do not show a Story's star rating and there is no way to filter or sort by stars; the editors had to write a script against story_versions() (starRating on the current version row) and call the setItemStars mutation by hand to list the 3-star published stories and raise them to 4. Ask: (1) stars column in stories list plus --stars N, --min-stars, --max-stars and --sort stars; also word count and last-published date columns; (2) stars, ratedBy and ratedAt in stories show; (3) papyrus stories set-stars --story LINEAGE --stars N (the earlier-filed command); same for the MCP equivalents. Stars are private newsroom data: never printed to published output. Gherkin: listing by stars, filtering, show, set-stars with validation (1-5, 0 clears), and a guard that nothing public gains a rating.
